name: Ninomiya Souichirou
source:
He is the president of the company Suou and Todaka work at.
A gentleman who has spare money, time, and mental energy to indulge women.
He's appropriately composed and tolerant for his age and he was born and raised with refined manners befit for elite society.
He's strict with himself and holds both the face of a devil and an angel, but at his root he is a calm and kind person.
His flower is the Lily of the Valley.
